name: model_op_chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd
description: Chunked gated delta-rule linear attention forward (vLLM-Ascend vllm_ascend/ops/triton/fla/chunk.py, chunk_gated_delta_rule). q, k [B, T, H, K] and v [B, T, H, V] bfloat16/float16 (float32 is rejected upstream), g [B, T, H] the log-space forget gate, beta [B, T, H] the delta-rule gate, scale float, initial_state [N, H, K, V] float32 or None. Computes the same gated delta-rule recurrence as the fused recurrent form but in chunks of 64 timesteps: per step the state decays by exp(g), v is corrected by the state's prediction for k, scaled by beta, rank-1 accumulated against k, and read out with q * scale. When use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel is set, q and k are L2-normalized in float32 with rsqrt(sum(x^2) + 1e-6) before scaling. With cu_seqlens the batch must be 1 and the sequences are packed, one initial state per segment. Returns (o [B, T, H, V] in q's dtype, final_state [N, H, K, V] or None when output_final_state is false). Note initial_state is laid out [N, H, K, V] here, transposed relative to the fused recurrent operator's [N, HV, V, K]. Inputs are not modified.
